ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Initiating a class income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
